nodes.description: Private owner address stored by Ownable; written in constructor, renounceOwnership and transferOwnership.
Private state variable initialized with _msgSender() at declaration time; used by the onlyOwner modifier instead of _owner, creating an access-control bypass.
Mapping of account balances mutated by _transfer and read by balanceOf.
Nested mapping of allowances written by _approve and read by allowance/transferFrom.
Total token supply constant assigned at deployment (1000 * 10**9 * 10**18).
Token name string 'Touhou Inu '.
Token symbol string 'TOUHOU    '.
Token decimals set to 18.
Context helper returning msg.sender as address payable.
View function returning the stored _owner address.
onlyOwner function that sets _owner to the zero address.
onlyOwner function that reassigns _owner to newOwner.
Touhou constructor; assigns the entire supply to _msgSender() and emits Transfer.
Public ERC20 approve; delegates to _approve with _msgSender() as owner.
Public transferFrom; performs _transfer then re-approves the reduced allowance.
Public transfer; moves tokens from _msgSender() to recipient via _transfer.
Internal transfer routine that subtracts from sender balance, adds to recipient balance and emits Transfer.
Private approval routine; if the owner argument is not the contract owner it silently resets the allowance to zero and emits Approval with the hardcoded value 4.
View function returning _allowances[owner][spender].
View function returning _balances[account].
View function returning _tTotal.
Modifier requiring newComer == _msgSender(); it never checks _owner, allowing the deployer to retain privileged access.
Address library helper performing a low-level call with value to an arbitrary payable recipient.
Address library helper performing a low-level call with value and bubbling up revert data.
Attacker-controllable caller address used by _msgSender, the constructor, the newComer initializer, transfer, transferFrom and the onlyOwner modifier.
Unauthorized allowance manipulation: when the owner argument differs from owner(), the allowance is zeroed and a fake Approval event with value 4 is emitted.
External low-level call transferring Ether to an arbitrary address before any state finalization, a reentrancy vector.
Balance arithmetic in _transfer: _balances[sender].sub(amount) and _balances[recipient].add(amount) with SafeMath checks.
Owner/from address parameter of _approve.
Spender/to address parameter of _approve.
Amount parameter of _approve.

Recipient address parameter of _transfer/transferFrom/transfer.
Amount parameter of _transfer/transfer/transferFrom.
Spender parameter of the public approve function.
Amount parameter of the public approve function.
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership.
Owner parameter of the allowance view function.
Spender parameter of the allowance view function.
Account parameter of balanceOf.
Payable recipient parameter of Address.sendValue.
Value amount parameter of Address.sendValue.
Local variable in the Ownable constructor capturing _msgSender() for _owner assignment.
Local boolean capturing the result of the low-level value call in sendValue.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by the _msgSender() helper used throughout the contract.
The newComer state variable is initialized with _msgSender() at declaration, tying privileged access to the deployer's msg.sender.
The constructor assigns the entire supply to _msgSender().
The onlyOwner modifier validates newComer against _msgSender() instead of the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier backed by newComer.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier backed by newComer.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership writes the zero address into _owner.
transferOwnership writes newOwner into _owner.
_approve branches on owner() to decide whether to store the amount or reset the allowance to zero.
The non-owner branch of _approve executes the unauthorized allowance reset and fake Approval emission.
_approve writes into the _allowances mapping.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom reads and consequently updates _allowances through _approve.
_transfer mutates the _balances mapping for sender and recipient.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
_transfer performs SafeMath sub/add on balances, the arithmetic surface of the contract.
transferFrom calls _approve after moving tokens to reduce the caller allowance.
transferFrom calls the internal _transfer routine.
The public approve function delegates to _approve.
The public transfer function delegates to _transfer.
Address.sendValue executes the low-level value call to the recipient before returning.
_functionCallWithValue triggers an external call with value to an arbitrary target, handing control to it.
totalSupply returns the _tTotal state variable.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender to _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter ol of _approve is a call-formal of the _approve function node.
Parameter tt of _approve is a call-formal of the _approve function node.
Parameter amount of _approve is a call-formal of the _approve function node.
Parameter sender is the source address used by the _transfer balance update.
Parameter recipient is the destination address used by the _transfer balance update.
Parameter amount is the arithmetic operand of the _transfer balance subtraction.
Parameter spender of approve is forwarded directly to _approve.
Parameter amount of approve is forwarded directly to _approve.
Parameter newOwner is written into the _owner state variable by transferOwnership.
Parameter owner indexes the _allowances mapping read by allowance.
Parameter spender indexes the _allowances mapping read by allowance.
Parameter account indexes the _balances mapping read by balanceOf.
Parameter recipient is the external call target of the unsafe value transfer in sendValue.
Parameter amount is the Ether value of the unsafe low-level call in sendValue.
Local variable msgSender in the constructor feeds the _owner assignment.
Local variable success records the outcome of the low-level call in sendValue.
